name: Tanabe
text: Tanabe (Japanese: 田辺市, Tanabe-shi, pronounced [tanabe ɕi]) is a city located in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 November 2021, the city has an estimated population of 70,972 in 35,076 households and a population density of 69 persons per km2. The total area of the city is 1,026.91 square kilometres (396.49 sq mi).

depictions.name: Tanabe
depictions.text: Tanabe, Wakayama Tanabe (田辺市) is a city in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan, formerly located in the south of Kii Province. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke infiltrated the city, which was overrun with bandits, while traveling through the province. Just south of the city, they established a kakurega at the furthest docks.
